prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ createRecipeBook }`. Each call creates an independent in-memory recipe book with methods `add`, `list`, `get`, `replace`, and `remove`. A recipe input must be a non-null, non-array object containing exactly `name`, `servings`, and `vegetarian`; `name` must be a non-empty trimmed string, `servings` an integer from 1 through 100, and `vegetarian` boolean. Malformed inputs throw `TypeError`, while an empty name or out-of-range servings throws `RangeError`. `add(input)` assigns sequential keys `r1`, `r2`, and so on and returns the stored recipe. `list()` returns recipes in insertion order. `get(key)` returns the recipe or `null`. `replace(key, input)` fully replaces an existing recipe while preserving its key and position, returning the replacement or `null` for an unknown key. `remove(key)` returns whether a recipe existed. Keys must be strings; non-string keys throw `TypeError`. All returned recipes and arrays must be fresh copies, so callers cannot mutate stored state. Inputs must never be mutated.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
